SHUYU_RELIC_BING_LENG_ZHI_HUI.title: Cold Wisdom
SHUYU_RELIC_BING_LENG_ZHI_HUI.descriptio: On the first turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}, then apply [gold]Frozen[/gold] to [blue]{FrozenAmount}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHUYU_RELIC_BING_LENG_ZHI_HUI.flavor: A textbook on ice magic. It contains many excellent ways to keep food cold!
SHUYU_RELIC_JI_HAN_ZHI_HUI.title: Glacial Wisdom
SHUYU_RELIC_JI_HAN_ZHI_HUI.description: On the first turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}, then apply [gold]Frozen[/gold] to up to [blue]{FrozenAmount}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHUYU_RELIC_JI_HAN_ZHI_HUI.flavor: The original notes on ice magic written by a grand mage. Few apprentices can make sense of them.
SHUYU_RELIC_BING_ZHI_LIN.title: Ice Scale
SHUYU_RELIC_BING_ZHI_LIN.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{IceShieldPower}[/blue] [gold]Ice Shield[/gold].
SHUYU_RELIC_BING_ZHI_LIN.flavor: A special magical material—and lesson one in material gathering for any apprentice ice mage.
SHUYU_RELIC_SHUI_JING_SHAO_PING.title: Crystal Flask
SHUYU_RELIC_SHUI_JING_SHAO_PING.descript: At the start of each combat, apply [gold]Chill[/gold] and [blue]{FragilePower}[/blue] [gold]Fragile[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SHUYU_RELIC_BING_SAN.title: Ice Parasol
SHUYU_RELIC_BING_SAN.flavor: A parasol shaped from ice. Keeps its owner dry while casting wide-reaching rain and snow spells.
SHUYU_RELIC_ZHA_REN_SUI_PIAN.title: Prickly Shard
SHUYU_RELIC_ZHA_REN_SUI_PIAN.description: At the end of your turn, gain [blue]{IceThornsPower}[/blue] [gold]Ice Thorns[/gold] for every [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] you have.
SHUYU_RELIC_ZHA_REN_SUI_PIAN.flavor: A fragment of a Frostforged weapon. When necessary, it can grow into a complete one.
SHUYU_RELIC_BAI_SHOU_TAO.title: White Gloves
SHUYU_RELIC_BAI_SHOU_TAO.description: After you discard your first card each turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. After your second, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. After your third, gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
SHUYU_RELIC_BAI_SHOU_TAO.flavor: Essential attire for an ice mage. Spellcasting demands spotless hands.
SHUYU_RELIC_JIE_JIE_BING_ZHANG.title: Barrier Staff
SHUYU_RELIC_JIE_JIE_BING_ZHANG.descripti: At the end of your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies for each card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHUYU_RELIC_BING_JIAN.title: Ice Mirror
SHUYU_RELIC_BING_JIAN.description: Whenever a [gold]Frostforged[/gold] card enters your [gold]Hand[/gold], apply [gold]Frozen[/gold] to it.
SHUYU_RELIC_BING_JIAN.flavor: Accelerates the activation of ice magic. Also keeps drinks cold in summer.
SHUYU_RELIC_XUE_TIAN_WA_WA.title: Snow Doll
SHUYU_RELIC_XUE_TIAN_WA_WA.description: Cards with "Forbidden Art" in their name cost {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} less. [gold]Misfortune[/gold] costs {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} less and gains [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
SHUYU_RELIC_XUE_TIAN_WA_WA.flavor: A tiny figure that bears curses in its caster's place.
SHUYU_RELIC_WEI_XING_XUE_REN.title: Miniature Snowman
SHUYU_RELIC_WEI_XING_XUE_REN.description: Upon pickup, choose up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [purple]Enchant[/purple] them with [purple]Auspicious Snow[/purple].
SHUYU_RELIC_WEI_XING_XUE_REN.flavor: A little doll that helps thaw cards.
